title: Reverse Holo Porygon2 143/182 Common Paradox Rift
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Porygon2 card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. It features a Reverse Holo finish and is a Common card with a card number of 143/182. The card depicts the character Porygon2 and is manufactured by Nintendo. This card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress.
